caption: #overthinking #overthinker #overthinkers #overthink
transcript: If overthinking is going to keep you up at night, then let it keep you up dreaming. Most people overthink the wound. You can overthink the healing because the mind only follows where you point it. It does not know the difference between the fear you rehearse and the peace you imagine. It just builds whatever you feed it, so feed it something softer. Overthink the calm that could be coming. Overthink the people who will feel like home. Overthink the version of you that finally breathes easy, not by pretending the hard things are not hard, but by refusing to let them be the only thing you replay. When the heavy thought returns, notice it, thank it, let it pass. Then turn the mind back toward what could go right. This is not a rule, it is an invitation. If you choose to overthink the good, write, I choose peace below and follow to continue.
